definitions.explanation: The amount of money paid regularly to an insurance company for coverage. Applies to health insurance, car insurance, life insurance, and other types.

examples.japanese: {保険料|ほけんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保険料|ほけんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My car insurance premium went up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保険料|ほけんりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The monthly insurance premium is deducted from my salary, so I don't need to pay it myself.

notes:
{保険料|ほけんりょう} is a compound of ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧ (insurance) and ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (fee/charge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保険料|ほけんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay premiums
- {保険料|ほけんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay premiums (formal)
- {保険料|ほけんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: premiums go up
- ⟦{月々|つきづき}→月々：30032_tsukizuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保険料|ほけんりょう}: monthly premiums

TYPES:
- {健康|けんこう}{保険料|ほけんりょう}: health insurance premiums
- {生命|せいめい}{保険料|ほけんりょう}: life insurance premiums
- ⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧{保険料|ほけんりょう}: car insurance premiums
